import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String inputStr = scanner.next();
        char[] str = inputStr.toCharArray();
        int len = str.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (i != 0 && i != len - 3) {
                if (str[i] == 'd') {
                    i++;
                    if (i < len && str[i] == 'o') {
                        i++;
                        if (i < len && str[i] == 't') {
                            str[i - 2] = '.';
                        }
                        i--;
                    }
                    i--;
                }
            }
        }

        int flag = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (i != 0 && i != len - 2) {
                if (str[i] == 'a') {
                    i++;
                    if (i < len && str[i] == 't') {
                        str[i - 1] = '@';
                        flag = 1;
                        break;
                    }
                    i--;
                }
            }
            if (flag == 1) {
                break;
            }
        }

        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            output.append(str[i]);
            if (str[i] == '.') {
                i += 2;
            }
            if (i < len && str[i] == '@') {
                i++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(output.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
